title: What Should an LLM Know? Knowledge-Guided Warm Starts for Software Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.23331v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) process gigabytes in minutes; human experts work far more slowly. Prior studies that explored combinations of human/AI optimizers ignore this gap. Those studies asked systems or humans to label too many examples (e.g., SynthCore needs over four dozen per trial). Here, we test human and AI knowledge under a budget where evaluation is practical (a few dozen labels or fewer).   We compare five baselines (random search, RRP, EZR, few-shot prompting, and a budget-matched SynthCore variant) against three ways to give an LLM domain knowledge before it proposes its first configurations: (1) AMP lists the domain's rules, then checks each candidate against them; (2) HKMA adds scouted data or documentation to the prompt; and (3) H-DKP has human experts correct the LLM's rules.   We find that domain knowledge improves the "start-up" phase of LLM optimization, but only when that knowledge is checked, by the LLM itself or

translated_title: LLM应该知道什么？面向软件优化的知识引导式热启动
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）几分钟内即可处理数GB的数据，而人类专家的工作速度要慢得多。先前探索人类/AI优化器组合的研究忽视了这一差距：它们要求系统或人类标注过多的样本（例如，SynthCore每次试验需要四十多个标注）。本研究在一个评估切实可行的预算下（几十个乃至更少的标注）测试人类与AI知识的作用。我们将五个基线方法（随机搜索、RRP、EZR、少样本提示，以及预算匹配的SynthCore变体）与三种在LLM提出首批配置之前向其注入领域知识的方式进行比较：(1) AMP列出该领域的规则，然后依据这些规则检查每个候选配置；(2) HKMA在提示中添加侦查得到的数据或文档；(3) H-DKP由人类专家纠正LLM的规则。我们发现，领域知识能够改善LLM优化的“启动”阶段，但前提是这些知识必须经过检验——无论是通过LLM自身还是……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究在切实可行的标注预算下，提出了三种向LLM注入领域知识的热启动方法（规则校验、文档增强、专家纠正），发现只有经过检验的领域知识才能真正改善LLM驱动软件优化的“启动”阶段。
en_tdlr: Under practical labeling budgets, domain-knowledge warm starts for LLM optimization improve the start-up phase of software optimization, but only when that knowledge is verified—by the LLM itself or by human experts.
